Make every profile answer what you do and how to buy.

WHEN TO DO THISOnce the name, main offer and contact method are settled.ESTIMATED WORK TIME1–3 hours
↗
Your one job

Make every profile answer what you do and how to buy.

01

Do this now

  1. 01

    Choose platforms based on buyer: Facebook/Instagram for many consumer offers, LinkedIn for relevant B2B relationships, WhatsApp Business for real customer messaging.

  2. 02

    Use consistent handles, real brand photos, concise biographies, contact/booking links and service information.

  3. 03

    Create a greeting, FAQ responses and a follow-up process with a named owner.

  4. 04

    Publish a pinned introductory post, how-it-works post and one clear offer using Hook → Information → CTA.

02

Copy this into ChatGPT

Replace anything in [square brackets] with your real business details. The prompt is a shortcut, not a substitute for the steps above.

READY-TO-USE PROMPT
Using only my verified business facts, write a consistent Facebook About section, Instagram bio, LinkedIn Company description (if B2B), WhatsApp Business greeting and pinned introduction. Follow Hook → Useful Info → One CTA. Include exact details I must fill before publishing. Don't invent opening hours, reviews, partner brands or booking links.
03

Finish with this

A consistent public profile kit with links and first posts.

Before moving on, check your work against the following:

  • Public details match across all platforms
  • Each profile has one usable contact route
  • An actual person can respond to inquiries
DON’T MAKE THIS MISTAKE

Opening four accounts without a plan to maintain or answer them.
